en: A vintage postcard featuring a black-and-white reproduction of an artwork depicting ballerinas rehearsing on stage. The scene shows several young women in tutus posed and dancing, with the stage and some stage scenery visible. Below the image, there is French text referencing the Louvre Museum and the artist Degas, specifically noting the artwork as 'Répétition d’un ballet sur la scène.'
